name: Tokyo-Big-Sight
tagline: Tokyo in 32 minutes and Otemachi in 33 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Koto City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 33 minutes to Otemachi, 46 minutes to Shinjuku, 45 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 5.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 5.8 m to 8.4 m, a difference of 2.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 pharmacy. The nearest hospital is 癌研有明病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 26 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

neighbours.lead: Kokusai-Tenjijo is ahead on how close the centre is, but Tokyo-Big-Sight is ahead on quiet.
